text: A particle of mass 1.2 kg moves in a straight line AB. It is projected with speed 7.5 m s from A
towards B and experiences a resistance force. The work done against this resistance force in moving
from A to B is 25 J.
A runner sets off from a point P at time t = 0, where t is in seconds. The runner starts from rest
and accelerates at 1.2 m s for 5 s. For the next 12 s the runner moves at constant speed before
decelerating uniformly over a period of 3 s, coming to rest at Q. A cyclist sets off from P at time
t = 10 and accelerates uniformly for 10 s, before immediately decelerating uniformly to rest at Q at
A van of mass 3200 kg travels along a horizontal road. The power of the van’s engine is constant and
equal to 36 kW, and there is a constant resistance to motion acting on the van.
A particle moves in a straight line. The particle is initially at rest at a point O on the line. At time t s
after leaving O, the acceleration a m s of the particle is given by a = 25 − t for 0 ≤ t ≤ 9.
